curriculum.course_title: New York State Next Generation Mathematics Learning Standards (2017, updated June 2019), Grades 6-8

source_notes: Extracted programmatically from the official NYSED P-12 standards PDF; two-column layout interleaves statements with marginalia, so statement text and cluster headings are best-effort pending Standards Mapping review.
Coherence chains are official vertical-alignment content published inside the document and are preserved per-row.
NY identifiers are jurisdiction-native (NY- / AI- / AII- / GEO- prefixes); they must never be merged with CCSS identifiers from other states' inventories by similarity.
New York has no repository packs, seeds, or skills; every row is NO_REPOSITORY_SPECIFIC_MAPPING_FOUND pending Standards Mapping work.

expectations.cluster_title: Investigate chance processes and develop, use, and evaluate probability models.
expectations.scope_summary: Understand that the probability of a chance event is a number between 0 and 1 inclusive, that expresses the likelihood of the event occurring. Larger numbers indicate greater likelihood. A probability near 0 indicates an unlikely event, a probability around ½ indicates an event that is neither unlikely nor likely, and a probability near 1 indicates a likely event .
